hero.eyebrow: TRACE ODD — THE ENTERPRISE ECOSYSTEM OF PAKISTAN
hero.headline: One Ecosystem. Every Movement. Fully Traced.
hero.subheadline: From the factory floor to the cricket ground, from your bus seat to your bike's ignition — Trace Odd is building Pakistan's first fully integrated digital infrastructure for transport, commerce, industry, and entertainment.

verticals.title: Bus-Fleet System
verticals.headline: Public Transport, Reimagined for the Modern Passenger.
verticals.copy: Trace Odd digitizes inter-city bus networks end-to-end. Fleet owners get live telemetry and automated route scheduling; passengers get smart seat booking, airline-style seat grids, and real-time tracking of every coach.

verticals.title: Goods Company System & Services
verticals.headline: The Freight Network That Moves Pakistan's Economy.
verticals.copy: A complete cargo ecosystem — automated freight dispatch, spot-market bidding and auctions, multi-owner fleet matrices, and escrow-protected carrier payments. Every load, every truck, every rupee accounted for.

verticals.title: B2B E-Commerce Platform
verticals.headline: Manufacturers Meet Verified Buyers. Direct.
verticals.copy: A high-throughput wholesale marketplace connecting manufacturers directly with distributors and bulk buyers. Volume-tier pricing, group order pooling, and encrypted commercial chat — with escrow clearing on every transaction.

verticals.title: Factory Supply Chain & Reseller Matrix
verticals.headline: End-to-End Supply Chain, From Factory Gate to Shop Shelf.
verticals.copy: The complete industrial pipeline linking factories, distributors, resellers, and shopkeepers — sealed with Trace Odd's proprietary Smart Auth Code: every bundle, carton, and unit cryptographically verified against counterfeiting.
features: Bundle → Carton → Packet → Unit trace hierarchy
Full lineage map for every product

verticals.title: Cricket Live Stream & Tournament Management
verticals.headline: Every Ball. Live. Everywhere.
verticals.copy: A dual-engine sports platform: a powerful manager panel for tournament setup, scoring, and multi-camera streaming — and an ultra-low-latency public portal delivering ball-by-ball scores and live video to fans nationwide.

verticals.title: TraceOdd Smart IoT Vehicle Security & Tracking
verticals.headline: Your Vehicle. Guarded by Trace Odd. 24/7.
verticals.copy: Affordable, subscription-based IoT tracking devices engineered for cars, commercial fleets, and motorbikes. Instant anti-theft immobilization, geofence monitoring, and high-frequency real-time GPS — all from your phone.
features: Simple monthly subscription — no upfront hardware cost

verticals.title: Universal Customer Super-App
verticals.headline: One App. Your Entire World, Connected.
verticals.copy: The single unified digital gateway for every Trace Odd user. Book a bus seat, track a cargo dispatch, order factory-direct, and monitor your vehicle's security — all under one mobile identity, one wallet, one history.
features: Interlinks bus bookings, cargo tracking & factory orders
Personal IoT vehicle alerts in one feed
One-time identity across the whole ecosystem
